newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 12,900 slaughter steers and 7,700 heifers; 68,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 18,900 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 62.50. Few Select and Choice 1-3 1250 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 62.00-62.50.
Wk to date - 68,900 Week Ago - 117,400 Year Ago - 20,000
